key_points: Lilly Endowment proposes another share sale after $386M proceeds in August, suggesting potential profit-taking.
TipRanks reports a regulatory win for Lilly's experimental cancer drug, adding pipeline upside.
Multiple sources highlight obesity drug data impressing Wall Street and bullish analyst action supporting shares.
LLY stock rose ~3.9% on Oct 7, extending its recent run.
Analyses versus Novo Nordisk indicate Lilly may still merit a premium in the GLP-1 market.
